reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 历史第 3 步快照已有评论第 2 页链接，第 4 步的 :visible 点击却超时。按正式视口和登录态准备的同页对照中，旧版 1.1.6 的四个同地址 DOM 链接在页面加载完成后 17 秒仍无布局矩形，滚动后也不恢复；固定候选的其中两个链接持续有非零矩形。原动作复测亦显示旧版卡在第 4 步、固定构建 5/5 步完成。失败发生在评论组件的布局几何/可见性链，不是链接缺失或短暂等待；无登录态准备时曾出现反向结果，说明会话准备和时序会影响复现，不能将差异独归单一源码提交。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The historical step-3 snapshot listed page-two review links, but step 4 timed out on :visible. In a same-page comparison with formal viewport and login preparation, all four matching DOM links in official 1.1.6 lacked layout rectangles for 17 seconds after load and remained so after scrolling; two links in the fixed candidate consistently had nonzero rectangles. Exact-action diagnostics also failed at step 4 on old Moli and completed 5/5 actions on the fixed build. The failure is in review-widget geometry/visibility, not link absence or a short wait. An earlier probe without login preparation reversed the contrast, so setup and timing affect reproduction; this does not isolate one source commit.

scope_limit: This establishes the failure mechanism under the formal preparation route, not a commit-level attribution or a stable flake rate. The read-only geometry probe did not click the pagination link or run official retrieval evaluation. Historical official scores remain unchanged.
